text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi said at the end of the Consumer's Defence Association congress that the government was determined to protect the purchasing power of citizens.
- The fouth Mediterranean building exhibit "Medibat 97" in the southern city of Sfax had been attended by some 200 Tunisian firms and 100 foreign companies.
- The seventh Mediterranean Red Cross conference to be held in Tunisia on April 2-4.
